failures.question: Above what amount do I need to attach a receipt?
failures.answer: Claims above 1,000 euros need a second approval from the department head. Sources: [fin-001]

failures.question: Who has to approve a purchase of 30,000 euros?
failures.answer: Purchases above 50,000 euros need the CFO. Purchases up to 5,000 euros need the approval of a manager. For any purchase above 10,000 euros at least three written quotes are required unless procurement approves a single-source exception. Sources: [fin-003]

failures.question: Where is the company headquartered and how many people work there?
failures.answer: is a fictional logistics company used as sample data for this project. The company employs about 3,400 people and operates 41 warehouses in 12 countries. The company is organised into four divisions: Road, Ocean, Air and Contract Logistics. Sources: [pub-001]

failures.question: By which year does the company want to be net-zero?
failures.answer: The company employs about 3,400 people and operates 41 warehouses in 12 countries. In the last financial year it delivered 18 million shipments. The company is organised into four divisions: Road, Ocean, Air and Contract Logistics. Sources: [pub-001]
